g.text: The correction removes the tested hydrogen-geometry defects

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #48596d

g.text: OpenMM route · 127 matched structures · coordinates read from saved PDBs, without further optimisation

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #48596d

g.text: Both corrected engines pass bond, angle, tetrahedral/α-H, plane and outward-trigonal checks on all 509 compatible inputs.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #48596d

g.text: Three of the original 512 require heavy-atom repair and are explicitly rejected. Geometric checks do not establish experimental accuracy.
